blocks.text: The Eiffel Tower is 450 metres tall, so from the top you can see about 90 km on a clear day.
We go up on the Saturday morning, before the queues, and have lunch on the second floor.

threads.quote: The Eiffel Tower is 450 metres tall

messages.text: It's 330 metres, antennas included. The 90 km horizon figure came from 450, so it needs redoing too. Does that change what you were planning around the view?

source.title: The Eiffel Tower just got 20 feet taller
source.passage: The Eiffel Tower grew from 324 meters (1,063 feet) tall to 330 meters (1,083 feet) now.
